posts.title: Notes to myself at the age of 29
posts.description: This year, I will be 30, and this is a note to myself before turning 30. I can start today. I can start after 41. I can start at the end of this month. I can start at 15:15. I can start later. I can restart. I can start even when I am tired. I can quit halfway and restart later. I am never late. There is no perfect time to start. Don't be afraid of failing. posts.title: Why we should support Iran against the US and Israel
posts.description: The Middle East is a mess. Right now, tensions between the US, Israel, and Iran are skyrocketing. And as someone on the Left, I wanted to talk about some facts. Now, whatever one’s critique of Iran’s internal politics, the core issue for the global Left is clear: Iran is a sovereign nation resisting Western imperialism.
